name: @kanzen/github-client
description: Client and contract types for the kanzen GitHub service consumer API: createGithubServiceClient (getAccessToken + CTA URL helpers), AppRouter, and the AccessResolution outcome union.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-banner --no-check -o dist/index.d.ts index.ts && bun build index.ts --outdir dist --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer-check.json
